channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lindbergh pede revogação da prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro após carta
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) urged the Supreme Federal Court to revoke Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest, claiming the ex-president violated precautionary measures by naming his son Flávio Bolsonaro as his 'spokesperson' and endorsing him as a presidential pre-candidate in a letter read during a live broadcast. Bolsonaro had called for unity behind Flávio's candidacy, presenting him as the best option to fight corruption, violence, and impoverishment in Brazil.

item.title: E agora, Valdemar? (por Mary Zaidan)
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, saw his 2026 electoral project collapse after endorsing the dynastic candidacy of Flávio Bolsonaro, losing electoral strength in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo, and losing Michelle Bolsonaro’s support. Although he built the party’s growth with Jair Bolsonaro’s help, he now faces a judicial block of R$119 million over corruption suspicions in parliamentary amendments, reflecting a long-standing pattern of impunity and political manipulation.

item.title: Carta de Bolsonaro expõe “extrema fragilidade” de Flávio, diz Caiado
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that former President Jair Bolsonaro's letter of support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) reveals 'extreme fragility' in the son's campaign. Caiado made the remark during a visit to the 27th Japan Festival in Goiás, saying the gesture by Bolsonaro senior indicates a lack of solidity in Flávio's candidacy. The comment comes amid the pre-campaign period for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Governo tenta nova reunião com EUA antes de decisão sobre tarifas
item.description: The Lula government is seeking a final meeting with U.S. USTR officials ahead of Trump's expected decision on new tariffs against Brazil by July 15, 2026. While the USTR says negotiations remain distant from agreement, Brazil prepares for two scenarios: likely tariff imposition or an unlikely delay for political reasons, which Brasilia would reject as unjustified.

item.title: Damares deixa plano de governo de Flávio: “Já fiz o que era preciso”
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) announced she will no longer coordinate human rights proposals in Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) government plan, stating she has already fulfilled her initial role. She said she may return to assist during a potential transition government. The decision was communicated in a public statement.

item.title: A estratégia do PT para tentar minar a hegemonia da oposição entre os evangélicos
item.description: The PT seeks to narrow its deficit among evangelical voters by capitalizing on Flávio Bolsonaro’s scandal involving Banco Master and Michelle Bolsonaro’s distancing from the government. The strategy establishes evangelical nuclei across all 27 federal units, led by Gutierres Barbosa, emphasizing grassroots dialogue, promotion of social programs, and temporary alliances with religious leaders — exemplified by the unsuccessful push to appoint Jorge Messias to the Supreme Court.

item.title: Damares deixa equipe do plano de governo de Flávio, diz site
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) announced she has left the government plan team of Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) after receiving insults and threats on social media from his allies. She stated she had already fulfilled her initial role and would only return during the transition government. Her decision came amid the growing rift between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio, following Michelle’s public claim of being ‘stabbed in the back’ by him and her resignation from PL Women’s leadership.

item.title: “Lula está gastando como se estivesse enfrentando uma pandemia”
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic agenda coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign, criticized Lula’s fiscal policy, claiming the government is increasing public spending as if facing a pandemic. She defended Paulo Guedes’ economic legacy and accused the current administration of fiscal irresponsibility.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro usa exemplo de Lula para falar sobre futuro político
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, in a recent conversation with allies, cited Lula's political trajectory as an example, stating she is not in a rush to pursue future political offices, noting that Lula took 30 years to reach the Presidency. The remarks came amid tensions with Flávio Bolsonaro. The content is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Jogos do Brasil na Copa provocaram corte de 50 GWh de energia renovável
item.description: During the 2026 World Cup, Brazil's matches led to a 50.4 GWh curtailment of solar and wind generation by the ONS due to supply-demand imbalances, with peak impacts during daytime games. The match against Norway at 5 p.m. on Sunday accounted for 22.8 GWh of curtailment, followed by the win over Japan at 2 p.m. on Monday with 15.1 GWh. These two games represented 75.2% of the total curtailment, equivalent to about six hours of Itaipu Dam's average hourly output.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sela apoio do Republicanos com promessa de indicação ao STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro secured the Republicanos party's support by promising to nominate its president, Marcos Pereira, for a STF vacancy in April 2028, when Luiz Fux retires. The deal was finalized in a recent conversation between the two.

item.title: Ajuste de 1,5% do PIB, envolvimento dos 3 Poderes, Caixa como “Itaú da Favela”: as mensagens econômicas da conselheira de Flavio Bolsonaro
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic advisor to Flávio Bolsonaro and former Caixa president, proposes a 1.5% of GDP fiscal adjustment involving Congress and the Judiciary to cut spending such as penduricalhos and super salaries. She advocates transforming Caixa into the 'favela's Itaú' to promote entrepreneurship and social mobility through digitalization and accessible credit. She also proposes securitizing up to R$250 billion of the Union's active debt and easing foreign investment in private debt, while ruling out cuts to Bolsa Família.

item.title: O que emperra Flávio?
item.description: The main weakness cited by readers for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy is the Banco Master case, mentioned by 50% of respondents. Second is his perceived submission to Trump at 35.3%, followed by the feud with Michelle (7.1%) and the belief that nothing weakens him (7.6%).

item.title: PT quer lotar Vila Euclides na estreia da campanha de Lula como em 1980
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign will be launched on August 16 at Vila Euclides Stadium in São Bernardo do Campo (SP), a site of historic significance tied to the 1979-1980 metalworkers' strikes where Lula rose to national prominence. The venue underscores the symbolism of labor movement roots and the origins of his political trajectory.

item.title: Preso pela PF, aliado de Flávio tem controle miliciano de área no RJ
item.description: The arrest of state deputy Márcio Canella (União Brasil-RJ) in the Federal Police's 'Unha e carne' operation exposes how Belford Roxo has become an electoral stronghold under strong militia influence, according to José Roberto de Toledo on UOL's A Hora. The analysis highlights how illegal armed groups' territorial control is directly interfering in local electoral processes.

item.title: Temer diz que Trump perguntou a ele: ‘Quando é que vocês vão invadir a Venezuela?’
item.description: Michel Temer recalled that Donald Trump, at a New York gala dinner in 2017, directly asked when Brazil would invade Venezuela, causing discomfort among Latin American leaders present. Temer advised Lula to 'soften his words' in relations with Trump to avoid escalation, particularly given the risk of the U.S. labeling Brazilian criminal groups as terrorist organizations. He stressed that aggressive responses to Trump’s statements would worsen diplomatic ties, despite the Brazilian government’s fiery rhetoric benefiting Lula’s campaign.

item.title: Massagem à mesa, pulseira de ouro e campeão eleito no voto: 8 curiosidades do torneio de pôquer que Neymar disputa após eliminação do Brasil
item.description: Neymar is competing in the No-Limit Hold’em Six-Handed event at the 2026 World Series of Poker in Las Vegas, shortly after Brazil’s World Cup elimination. The tournament, part of a 100-event festival running from May to July, features a $10,000 buy-in and awards gold bracelets to winners. Despite his celebrity status, Neymar plays under standard rules, facing the fast-paced, six-handed freezeout format with no rebuys allowed.

item.title: Damares deixa equipe do plano de governo de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) decided to stop collaborating on Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) government plan after being targeted by attacks from his allies, amid the controversy involving Michelle Bolsonaro’s criticisms. Damares stated she had already fulfilled her initial contribution to the human rights section and that Flávio had not reached out again, saying he 'is running away'.

item.title: Às vésperas das convenções, Lula e Flávio correm para fechar palanques
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are still working to define alliances in seven states ahead of party conventions, with Lula having advanced in Goiás and Tocantins, leaving only Minas Gerais undefined for the PT. Flávio faces impasses in Minas Gerais, Amapá, Pernambuco, Alagoas, Maranhão and Espírito Santo, despite progress in negotiations in the latter state. The definition of state-level slates is crucial to bolstering presidential campaigns ahead of the October elections.

item.title: Imparáveis: Flávio Bolsonaro colhe o preço de subestimar Michelle
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro launched the 'Imparáveis' movement, directly challenging Flávio Bolsonaro and establishing herself as an autonomous political force within the right, dissolving PL Mulher to build her own independent base. According to journalist João Bosco Rabello, this family rift constitutes a monumental strategic error by Flávio, who, by confronting his stepmother, fractured his own platform and exposed his presidential campaign to the risk of a crushing defeat due to internal chaos within the PL.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio quer virar página após nova ação contra Valdemar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign seeks to distance itself from the investigation into Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, following the blocking of R$119.2 million in assets by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino. The party’s strategy is to treat the case separately from the presidential candidacy to avoid spillover effects on the senator, while labeling the action as political persecution and affirming that Valdemar will provide the necessary explanations.

item.title: Mudança de rumo
item.description: The article highlights the role reversal between Lula and Bolsonaro in Brazil's presidential elections: while in 2018 Bolsonaro was the surprise candidate with Lula in prison, now Bolsonaro is the one incarcerated and has rushed to nominate his son, Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, as his replacement, hoping to transfer his voter base. Lula, meanwhile, delayed accepting he would not be a candidate, believing it would ease the transfer of votes to Haddad — a strategy that failed. The piece is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Já passou da hora de aceitar que a seleção brasileira não é mais protagonista
item.description: The author reflects on Brazil's early exit from the World Cup, interpreting it as a sign of prolonged decline and accepting that Brazil is no longer a protagonist in world football. He connects this disappointment to the onset of the pre-election period, suggesting that the mix of politics and football may finally be over. The tone is one of critical resignation, referencing a meme that prioritizes personal well-being over collective suffering caused by the national team's losses.

item.title: A democracia oligárquica
item.description: Professor Joaquim Falcão released a 254-page book titled 'The Oligarchy of Powers and the Crisis of Democracy', analyzing power concentration and democratic challenges in Brazil. The work is available exclusively to subscribers via registration at the article's link. Its release coincides with the post-World Cup period, preceding the 2026 electoral campaign.

item.title: Ministros do STF adiam Código de Ética para depois das eleições
item.description: The STF has postponed the approval of its Code of Ethics until after the 2026 elections, citing the sensitive political climate and the need to build internal consensus. Ministers, including President Edson Fachin, emphasize that legitimacy matters more than speed, referencing lengthy processes in Germany and the U.S. The delay aims to prevent the initiative from being politicized in the electoral debate and to keep focus on the substance of the proposal.

item.title: Entrevista: 'Não gosto de ser chamada de Paulo Guedes de saia', diz Daniella Marques, cotada para vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic agenda coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro and potential running mate, rejects the label 'Paulo Guedes in a skirt', stating her talents are complementary to his. She supports the Bolsonaro legacy but is more cautious, proposing a 1.5% of GDP spending reduction without endorsing the DDD framework. Flávio Bolsonaro suggests creating a governance body with other branches to discuss the budget, with no final decision yet on whether the fiscal anchor will be spending or debt ceiling.

item.title: 'Senhor presidente': cartas a Lula têm queixas sobre custo de vida, relatos de dívidas e até pedido de carro novo
item.description: Brazilians continue sending handwritten letters to President Lula to report hardships related to the cost of living, debt, and requests for assistance, such as pension adjustments or support for small businesses. Despite the digital age, over 21,000 letters were received during his third term, reflecting limited access to effective channels for resolving daily struggles. The Personal Office registers and forwards these demands, but many responses are perceived as inadequate by the senders.

item.title: Rogéria, Michelle e Ana Cristina: rixas e investigações marcam vida política de mulheres de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Bolsonaro family is facing internal conflicts and investigations, highlighted by the rift between Michelle Bolsonaro and her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro, who is running for president in 2026. Michelle is reluctant to support the senator's campaign, fearing it could damage her influence among women and evangelicals. The family's history reveals a pattern of political disputes and investigations involving Jair Bolsonaro's wives, including Rogéria and Ana Cristina Valle, linked to 'rachadinhas' schemes and misuse of public funds.

item.title: Entenda os recados enviados por Jair Bolsonaro na carta lida por Flávio em meio a disputa de senador com Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro read a letter signed by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, in which the former president refers to his son as his 'spokesperson' and asks for support for Flávio's presidential pre-candidacy. The text, attributed to Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest for attempted coup, does not mention Michelle Bolsonaro, with whom Flávio has been publicly at odds in recent weeks.

item.title: Feminicídio é parte mais visível de explosão da violência contra mulheres
item.description: Domestic violence cases against women in São Paulo rose 14.6% in the first five months of 2026, from 135,000 to 154,000, with femicides increasing 15.7% (from 108 to 125). Governor Tarcísio de Freitas promoted public security reforms, including appointing the first woman to lead the state military police. Threats were the most reported crime, growing by 13.5%.

item.title: Posseiro que vendeu mansão a Richarlison é condenado por estelionato
item.description: Marquinhos, a businessman close to former deputy Alencar da Silveira and friend of Richarlison, was convicted of fraud in Belo Horizonte for selling vehicles with post-dated checks. He had sold Richarlison, through Sports 70, a mansion in Angra dos Reis whose land belongs to the Union, sparking a legal dispute with lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who secured possession through the SPU. The property, valued at R$ 10 million, once belonged to singer Clara Nunes and is located on Ilha Comprida.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio manifestam apoio à carta de Bolsonaro
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro reinforced their support after he read a letter from former President Jair Bolsonaro, in which the ex-president designated him as his 'spokesperson' and 'best option' to combat corruption, violence, and impoverishment in Brazil. The support came despite tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro over alliances in Ceará, though she was not mentioned in the letter or by supporters. Figures including Nikolas Ferreira, Rogério Marinho, Onyx Lorenzoni, Mário Frias, Sanderson, and Rodrigo Valadares emphasized the need for unity behind Flávio’s candidacy.

item.title: Renan Santos usa cidades isoladas como laboratório de pré-campanha
item.description: Pre-candidate Renan Santos of the Missão party visited Melgaço (PA) to use isolated cities as a pre-campaign laboratory, highlighting the historical absence of presidential candidates in the region. Local residents, such as Cilene Malheiro, praised the visit, noting that while mayoral and council candidates had come before, no presidential pre-candidate had ever visited.

item.title: Aparente conflito entre Michelle e Flávio é método de mobilização do bolsonarismo
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro's video criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro should not be seen as a sign of family discord or communication error, but as a deliberate mobilization tactic within Bolsonarism, where even internal family fractures are leveraged to engage supporters. The author argues that exposing such fissures serves to keep the base energized and polarized. This reflects a communication strategy that turns vulnerabilities into tools for political engagement.

item.title: Vícios oligárquicos estão nos três Poderes
item.description: Professor Joaquim Falcão has released the book 'The Oligarchy of Powers and the Crisis of Democracy', denouncing the presence of oligarchic vices in the three branches of government. The 256-page work arrives in bookstores as the World Cup ends and the 2026 electoral campaign begins, highlighting a scenario of power concentration threatening Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Lindbergh pede a Moraes a revogação da prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro após carta a Flávio
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) requested Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF to revoke Jair Bolsonaro's humanitarian house arrest, citing violations of precautionary measures, including social media use through third parties. He claims Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) read a letter from the ex-president on social media, breaching restrictions, and demands Flávio pay a R$100,000 fine for an act against the dignity of Justice.

item.title: “A partir de 2027 será pior do que Dilma 2”, diz Caiado
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that Brazil's economic situation in 2027 will be worse than Dilma Rousseff's second term, blaming fiscal imbalance caused by the Lula government's measures. He criticized the R$187.2 billion in direct benefits to voters announced this year, of which R$176.7 billion exceeds the spending cap, equivalent to 94% of the total. The remark was made at the Japan Festival in São Paulo, with no response from the Planalto Palace at the time of publication.

item.title: Caiado diz que carta de Bolsonaro é sinal de 'extrema fragilidade' na campanha de Flávio
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Jair Bolsonaro's letter naming Flávio Bolsonaro as spokesperson, calling it a sign of 'extreme fragility' in the senator's campaign. Caiado argued that reliance on paternal intervention during crises shows unpreparedness to govern and raises doubts about Flávio's ability to handle greater challenges if elected. He emphasized that candidates must speak for themselves and meet societal expectations, not act as proxies for others.

item.title: Lindbergh diz que carta de Bolsonaro viola medidas e pede ao STF revogação da domiciliar
item.description: Federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) announced he will file a petition with the STF to revoke Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest, claiming the former president violated precautionary measures by having his son Flávio publicly read a letter designating him as his political spokesperson. Lindbergh argues that using third parties to disseminate political messages breaches the ban on social media use imposed by the court.

item.title: Caiado ironiza Flávio depois leitura de carta de Bolsonaro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for reading live a letter of support from former President Jair Bolsonaro, implying the candidate relies on paternal approval to establish leadership. Caiado argued that a president must make independent decisions, especially during international crises, and that leadership is demonstrated, not inherited. Bolsonaro’s letter urged right-wing unity and endorsed Flávio as his 'spokesperson' to fight corruption, violence, and impoverishment.

item.title: Com lei do astronauta Marcos Pontes, Ayrton Senna entra para lista de ‘Heróis da Pátria’
item.description: Law 15.447/2026, signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on June 30, 2026, officially recognized Ayrton Senna as a National Hero, stemming from a bill introduced in 2024 by Senator Marcos Pontes, astronaut and former minister. Senna is now inscribed in the Book of Heroes and Heroines of the Fatherland (Steel Book), housed in the Pantheon of the Fatherland in Brasília, where names are permanently engraved in steel. The proposal was approved by the Senate’s Sports Committee in May 2026, without requiring a plenary vote.

item.title: Valdemar sobre Michelle disputar Senado no DF: Acho que ela sai candidata e vai chegar em 1º
item.description: The national president of the Liberal Party (PL), Valdemar Costa Neto, stated that he believes former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro will run for the Federal Senate in the Distrito Federal and has a strong chance of finishing first. The comment came after internal party conflicts with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who is a pre-candidate for president.

item.title: Caiado ironiza Flávio por carta de Bolsonaro: “Liderança não se herda”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for publicly reading a letter from Jair Bolsonaro endorsing him as a presidential candidate, stating that leadership is not inherited but demonstrated. Caiado argued that voters want a president who can act independently, especially during international crises involving Venezuela, Bolivia, or Argentina, and not one who constantly seeks approval from another leader. He also noted Flávio’s age (45) as a reason why he must prove he can make tough decisions on his own.

item.title: Nikolas reforça apoio a Flávio: “Não haverá espaço para vaidade”
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) reinforced his support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential pre-candidacy, stating he will follow the guidance of former President Jair Bolsonaro and calling for unity among political allies. In a post on X, Nikolas said that since Bolsonaro's decision, he has stood alongside the senator and emphasized that 'there will be no room for vanity'.

item.title: Michelle é “importantíssima” para campanha de Flávio, diz Valdemar
item.description: The national president of the PL, Valdemar Costa Neto, urged party unity behind Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential pre-candidacy, stating that the support of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro will be 'crucial' and decisive for the campaign. He acknowledged the election will be difficult but expressed confidence in the bolsonarist bloc's strength to prevail.

item.title: A falta de apetite de Paulo Gonet para delações premiadas
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet has been avoiding plea bargain agreements, rejecting proposals from figures such as banker Daniel Vorcaro and former BRB president Paulo Henrique Costa. His stance is based on demanding maximum financial restitution to victims and concerns about future challenges to the proportionality of such agreements, particularly following the negative aftermath of Operation Lava-Jato on the credibility of plea bargains.

item.title: O comportamento dos seguidores de Michelle Bolsonaro após polêmica com o enteado
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro received both support and backlash after posting a video accusing her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, of mistreating her and dismissing her political support during a Ceará election dispute. While she maintained her 8.2 million Instagram followers, she lost 1,300 on X (formerly Twitter), where critics—including allies of Eduardo Bolsonaro—launched harsh attacks, accusing her of harming Flávio’s presidential campaign and aiding Lula’s re-election.

item.title: Nikolas reforça apoio a Flávio após carta escrita por Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) reinforced his support for Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential pre-candidacy, following former President Jair Bolsonaro's call for unity among allies in a letter released by his eldest son. Nikolas stated he will work for the 'Flávio President' project and urged that internal disagreements be set aside, emphasizing there will be no room for vanity or internal disputes within the political group.

item.title: Com música cantada pela torcida, Noel Gallagher diz não torcer pela Inglaterra, mas aprovou homenagem
item.description: Noel Gallagher of Oasis stated he does not support England's national team in the 2026 World Cup, identifying as an Irish and Manchester City fan. Manchester City supporter. He approved of England fans singing his song 'Wonderwall' during matches, calling it a 'magical' moment. Gallagher also said he hoped to see Brazil and Argentina reach the final.

item.title: Caiado diz que liderança 'não se herda' após Flávio ler carta de Bolsonaro
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), stating that political leadership is not inherited, after Flávio read a letter attributed to former President Jair Bolsonaro in support of his own presidential bid.
